title: Frites
notes: The first bath can be done a few hours ahead: leave the blanched frites on their tray and give them the second bath just before serving.

steps.text: Rinse {potato}. Drain and dry thoroughly in a tea towel.
Pour {oil} into a deep fryer or a large heavy pot, no more than half full. Heat to 150 °C.
Fry the potatoes in batches, without crowding the oil.
Lift out onto a tray lined with kitchen paper and leave to cool.
Raise the oil to 190 °C. Fry the frites again in batches, until golden and crisp.
Drain on fresh kitchen paper. Season with fine salt and serve at once.
